question: The final figure on a crane load sheet, in kN, is 10 kN of wind allowance added to a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 2 cranes, each with 5 identical hoists, so it is the single-hoist force multiplied by 5 and then by 2. A single hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 121 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 12x + 32 = 0. What is the final figure, in kN?

The total in a courier report, in kJ, is 5 times a depot figure. The depot figure is 7 times a per-bike figure expressed in kJ. The per-bike figure is the energy of motion of a 33,000 g cargo bike moving at a speed in m/s equal to 12 times the greatest common divisor of 161 and 232. What is the total in the report, in kJ?

The final figure in a sled-test report, in kJ, is 25 kJ of reserve added to a net figure. The net figure is a sled's energy of motion, expressed in kJ, minus a 9 kJ braking allowance. The sled has a mass of 21,000 g and moves at a speed in m/s equal to 14 less than the area under y = 5x² + 5x between x = 1 and x = 3. What is the final figure, in kJ?

A 193 kg engine block on a factory hoist is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 3 times the sum of 2 and 5. The hoist supplies the force needed for this, less 7 N contributed by a counter-spring. The hoist chain is 7 m long. There are 8 hoists per bay, 8 bays per hall, and 3 halls, so the plant total is the per-hoist value multiplied by 8, then by 8, then by 3. What is the plant total, in N?

A 28 kg test sled moves at a speed in m/s equal to the second derivative of y = 4x³ - 2x² evaluated at x = 2. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. The sled track is 350 m long. Four sleds run per session and 5 sessions are run, so the campaign total is the per-sled value multiplied by 4 and then by 5. What is the campaign total, in kJ?

A 44,000 g cargo bike on a delivery route moves at a speed in m/s equal to 2 times the sum of 7 and 13. Its energy of motion is measured. The logger subtracts 21 J of rolling loss, then adds 4 J of sensor offset, and then adds 26 J of stored spring energy. What energy does the logger report, in J?

The total in a hoist report, in N, is 5 times a bay figure. The bay figure is 29 N less than the combined force of 4 identical hoists. Each hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 49,000 g load at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 8x + 7 = 0. The hoist cable is 12 m long. What is the total in the report, in N?

A 172,000 g pallet on a warehouse lift is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 9x + 18 = 0. The hoisting force needed for this is converted to kN. There are 7 lifts per building and 11 buildings, so the site figure is the per-lift value multiplied by 7 and then by 11. A 3 kN allowance is then added. What is the final figure, in kN?

A 44,000 g cart creeps along a lab rail at a speed in m/s equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 0x between x = 0 and x = 1. The logger takes the cart's energy of motion and subtracts a 23 J budget, recording a negative balance when the cart is under budget. Three carts run, so the group balance is 3 times that. The rail is 6 m long. A 17 J allowance is added to the group balance, and the result is multiplied by 5 for the 5 sessions. What is the final balance, in J?

The total in a depot report, in kJ, is 12 times a line figure. The line figure is the combined energy of motion of 5 identical parcels, converted to kJ. Each parcel has a mass of 9 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 339 and 65. The conveyor belt is 14 m long. What is the total in the report, in kJ?

A 15 kg tool head on a lathe carriage is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 1·x² at the point x = 1. The drive supplies the force needed for this, less 18 N contributed by a spring, and the result is converted to kN. The carriage travel is 90 cm. The machine log records a net force by subtracting a 14 kN clamping load, with the drive direction positive, so it may be negative, and then multiplies by 6 for the 6 carriages in the cell. What net force does the log record, in kN?

A 21 kg projectile on a test range flies at a speed in m/s equal to 6 times the sum of 7 and 4. Its energy of motion plus 30 J of launcher offset is the per-shot figure. Nine shots make a volley, 3 volleys make a session, and 11 sessions are run. The campaign total is therefore the per-shot value multiplied by 9, then by 3, then by 11. What is the campaign total, in J?

A 40,000 g cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 369 and 51. Eight such carts run together, so the combined energy of motion is 8 times that of one cart, and the combined value is converted to kJ. A 26 kJ battery reserve is added. Ten such groups operate, so the total is 10 times the group figure. What is the total, in kJ?

The final figure in a drone-hangar report, in kN, is a combined thrust expressed in kN minus a 20 kN tie-down load, with the thrust direction positive, so it may be negative. The combined thrust is that of 12 hangars each holding 12 drones, so it is the single-drone thrust multiplied by 12 and then by 12. A single drone supplies the thrust needed to accelerate its 6,000 g body at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 299 and 267. What is the final figure, in kN?

A 93 kg sled on a test track is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 11. The booster supplies the thrust needed for this, less 14 N contributed by a tailwind, and the result is converted to kN. The track is 500 m long. Six sleds run together, so the combined figure is 6 times that, and 16 kN of margin is then added. What is the final figure, in kN?

The final figure in a press-hall report, in N, is 13 N less than a hall total. The hall total is 9 times a line figure. The line figure is 28 N of margin added to the combined force of 6 identical presses. Each press supplies the force needed to accelerate a 140 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 2x² + 1·x between x = 2 and x = 3. The press hall is 60 m long. What is the final figure, in N?

The figure at the end of a bike-team report is in kJ and is obtained by converting a team total from J to kJ. The team total is the combined energy of motion of 6 identical riders. Each rider and bike together have a mass of 55 kg and move at a speed in m/s equal to 6 times the greatest common divisor of 141 and 42. The course is 40 km long. What figure ends the report, in kJ?

The final figure on a hoist sheet, in kN, is 29 kN of counterweight assist subtracted from a subtotal. The subtotal is 23 kN of structural allowance added to a hoisting force expressed in kN. The hoisting force is what is needed to accelerate a 139 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to 11 times the larger root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. What is the final figure, in kN?

A 109,000 g beam is accelerated by a jack at a rate in m/s² equal to the second derivative of y = 1·x³ - 4x² evaluated at x = 3. The jacking force needed for this is converted to kN, and 20 kN of dead-load allowance is added. The beam is 8 m long. Ten jacks operate, so the combined figure is 10 times that, and 23 kN of counterweight assist is then subtracted. What is the final figure, in kN?

The total in a sled-fleet energy report, in kJ, is 9 times a per-sled figure. The per-sled figure is obtained by taking the energy of motion of a sled, expressed in kJ, and adding 22 kJ of reserve and then a further 22 kJ of margin. The sled has a mass of 51,000 g and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 11. What is the total in the report, in kJ?

An 81,000 g sled is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 3x² + 0x between x = 1 and x = 4. The booster supplies the thrust needed for this plus 16 N of rail friction. The track is 900 m long. There are 9 sleds per session and 4 sessions, so the campaign total is the per-sled value multiplied by 9 and then by 4. From the campaign total, 3 N of sensor bias is subtracted. What is the final figure, in N?

The figure at the end of a cart-fleet energy sheet, in kJ, is 4 times a per-cart balance. The per-cart balance is the energy of motion of a 23 kg cart, expressed in kJ, minus a 15 kJ energy budget, recorded as negative when the cart is under budget. The cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 12x + 32 = 0. The cart track is 35 m long. What figure ends the sheet, in kJ?

A 3 kg parcel on a sorting conveyor moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 0x² at the point x = 1. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. Twelve parcels ride each belt and there are 3 belts, so the depot value is the per-parcel value multiplied by 12 and then by 3. The belt is 25 m long. The depot records that value minus a 17 kJ energy budget, negative when under budget. What does the depot record, in kJ?

The final line of a press-test sheet is a net force in kN, found by adding a 15 kN hydraulic assist to an earlier net figure, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. That earlier figure was a drive force expressed in kN with a 28 kN return-spring load subtracted. The drive force is what is needed to accelerate a 155,000 g die at a rate in m/s² equal to the sum of 2k - 1 for k from 1 to 4. What is on the final line, in kN?

An 89,000 g sled is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 13. Eight boosters each supply the thrust needed for this, and the range sums the 8 outputs and converts the sum to kN. The track is 1.1 km long. From that value, 8 kN of rail-brake load is subtracted, and then 25 kN of margin is added. What is the final figure, in kN?
